Choose One, Permanently

The Last Rebinding

Once per day, when you defeat a hostile spirit or ghost-machine you've Named, you may fully re-bind it — not weaken it, not delay it, but capture it whole as a permanent bound servant-spirit, no matter which Ward you chose at 1st level. Every hazard you end this way is one more soul put back to useful work, whatever that says about you.

Final Exorcism

Once per day, Break the Anchor doesn't just end a hostile spirit's rampage — it unmakes the Anchor itself, permanently. What's destroyed this way doesn't linger, doesn't reform, and can never again haunt anything. In a world where the dead have nowhere else to go, this is the rarest mercy anyone can offer them.
